"use client";

import { Box, Circle, Float } from "@chakra-ui/react"

export const FloatBasic = () => (
  <Box position="relative" w="80px" h="80px" bg="bg.emphasized">
    <Float>
      <Circle size="5" bg="red" color="white">
        3
      </Circle>
    </Float>
  </Box>
)

"use client";

import { Avatar, Badge, Box, Float } from "@chakra-ui/react"

export const FloatWithAvatar = () => {
  return (
    <Box display="inline-block" pos="relative">
      <Avatar.Root size="lg" shape="rounded">
        <Avatar.Image src="https://i.pravatar.cc/150?img=5" />
        <Avatar.Fallback />
      </Avatar.Root>
      <Float placement="bottom-end">
        <Badge size="sm" variant="solid" colorPalette="teal">
          New
        </Badge>
      </Float>
    </Box>
  )
}

# Chakra UI float

6 published Chakra UI float examples with complete pinned source and MIT attribution.

## Installation

- Complete MIT examples with a ChakraProvider using defaultSystem.
- Reuse the application-level ChakraProvider when integrating; keep HiddenInput in checkbox and switch compositions for keyboard and form semantics.

- Copy every returned file and preserve the MIT licence notice.
- Render the returned preview.tsx example, or integrate the example into your existing provider.
